ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p LEMURLOOT webshell (human2.aspx) drop in MOVEit Transfer wwwroot
ucs.description: Hunts the canonical Cl0p / FIN11 mass-exploitation IOC from CVE-2023-34362 — the MOVEit Transfer IIS worker (w3wp.exe) writing the LEMURLOOT webshell `human2.aspx` (or the dynamically-named `app_web_*.dll` backdoor variant) into the MOVEit `wwwroot`. Progress/Ipswitch's own w3wp.exe NEVER writes .aspx pages into its own webroot under normal operation; this file-write pattern is essentially pathognomonic for Cl0p's May–June 2023 campaign and the variants that have followed.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEit Transfer\\wwwroot\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\MOVEitTransfer\\wwwroot\\*") AND Filesystem.process_name="w3wp.exe" AND (Filesystem.file_name="human2.aspx" OR Filesystem.file_name="LEMURLOOT*" OR Filesystem.file_name="app_web_*.dll" OR (Filesystem.file_name="*.aspx" AND Filesystem.file_name!="human.aspx")) by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.user host
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let MoveItPaths = dynamic([@"\MOVEit Transfer\wwwroot\", @"\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot\"]);
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where FolderPath has_any (MoveItPaths)
| where FileName =~ "human2.aspx"
    or FileName matches regex @"(?i)^(LEMURLOOT|app_web_[a-z0-9]{6,}\.dll)$"
    or (FileName endswith_cs ".aspx" and FileName !~ "human.aspx")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, SHA256,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessAccountDomain
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let MoveItPaths = dynamic([@"\MOVEit Transfer\wwwroot\", @"\MOVEitTransfer\wwwroot\"]);
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where ActingProcessName has "w3wp.exe"
| where TargetFilePath has_any (MoveItPaths)
| where TargetFileName =~ "human2.aspx"
    or TargetFileName matches regex @"(?i)^(LEMURLOOT|app_web_[a-z0-9]{6,}\.dll)$"
    or (TargetFileName endswith_cs ".aspx" and TargetFileName !~ "human.aspx")
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, TargetFileName, TargetFilePath,
          TargetFileSHA256, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine,
          ActorUsername
| order by TimeGenerated desc

ucs.title: [LLM] Cl0p MFT post-exploit: w3wp.exe on MOVEit/GoAnywhere/Serv-U spawning shell or recon binaries
ucs.description: Generalises the Cl0p webshell post-exploitation pattern across all three of their preferred Managed File Transfer victim platforms — MOVEit (CVE-2023-34362), GoAnywhere MFT (CVE-2023-0669) and Serv-U (CVE-2024-28995). The IIS worker hosting any of those apps spawning cmd/powershell/whoami/net/nltest/certutil/bitsadmin is the hands-on-keyboard fingerprint of GRACEFUL SPIDER (Cl0p) after the initial CVE drops the webshell.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="w3wp.exe" AND (Processes.parent_process="*MOVEit*" OR Processes.parent_process="*GoAnywhere*" OR Processes.parent_process="*Serv-U*" OR Processes.parent_process="*Accellion*") AND Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","nltest.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash host
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let MftMarkers = dynamic(["MOVEit", "GoAnywhere", "Serv-U", "Accellion"]);
let ShellRecon = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","nltest.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (MftMarkers)
    or InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (MftMarkers)
| where FileName in~ (ShellRecon)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let MftMarkers = dynamic(["MOVEit", "GoAnywhere", "Serv-U", "Accellion"]);
let ShellRecon = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","whoami.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","ipconfig.exe","systeminfo.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","nltest.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe","curl.exe"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where ParentProcessName has "w3wp.exe"
| where ParentProcessCommandLine has_any (MftMarkers)
| extend ChildBin = tostring(split(ActingProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where ChildBin in~ (ShellRecon)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine,
          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: Cl0p MFT Webshell Command Execution via w3wp.exe Spawning Shell or Recon
id: 4c2b18d7-7a52-4f1c-bb24-92f1e8b6d4f2
status: experimental
description: Detects an IIS worker (w3wp.exe) whose command line references a Managed File Transfer application (MOVEit / GoAnywhere / Serv-U / Accellion) spawning shell or discovery binaries. This is the canonical Cl0p / FIN11 / TA505 post-exploitation pattern after deploying a webshell via CVE-2023-34362, CVE-2023-0669, or CVE-2024-28995.
references:
    - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/unc4857-moveit-transfer-cve-2023-34362
    - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-158a
    - https://www.fortra.com/security/advisory/fi-2023-01
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/28
tags:
    - attack.initial-access
    - attack.t1190
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.001
    - attack.t1059.003
    - attack.discovery
    - cl0p
    - fin11
    - ta505
logsource:
    category: process_creation
    product: windows
detection:
    selection_parent:
        ParentImage|endswith: '\w3wp.exe'
        ParentCommandLine|contains:
            - 'MOVEit'
            - 'GoAnywhere'
            - 'Serv-U'
            - 'Accellion'
    selection_child:
        Image|endswith:
            - '\cmd.exe'
            - '\powershell.exe'
            - '\pwsh.exe'
            - '\whoami.exe'

            - '\net1.exe'

            - '\ipconfig.exe'
            - '\systeminfo.exe'
            - '\tasklist.exe'
            - '\quser.exe'
            - '\curl.exe'
    condition: selection_parent and selection_child
falsepositives:
    - Coordinated vendor support sessions (should be rare and pre-approved)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\w3wp.exe OR *\\W3wp.exe OR *\\W3WP.EXE) @ParentCommandLine:(*MOVEit* OR *GoAnywhere* OR *Serv-U* OR *Accellion* OR *moveit* OR *goanywhere* OR *serv-u*) @Image:(*\\cmd.exe OR *\\Cmd.exe OR *\\powershell.exe OR *\\PowerShell.exe OR *\\pwsh.exe OR *\\whoami.exe OR *\\WHOAMI.EXE OR *\\net.exe OR *\\Net.exe OR *\\net1.exe OR *\\nltest.exe OR *\\certutil.exe OR *\\bitsadmin.exe OR *\\ipconfig.exe OR *\\systeminfo.exe OR *\\tasklist.exe OR *\\quser.exe OR *\\curl.exe)

#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^w3wp\.exe$/i
| regex("(MOVEit|GoAnywhere|Serv-U|Accellion)", field=ParentImageFileName, strict=false) OR regex("(MOVEit|GoAnywhere|Serv-U|Accellion)", field=ParentCommandLine, strict=false)
| ImageFileName=/\\(cmd|powershell|pwsh|whoami|net1?|nltest|certutil|bitsadmin|ipconfig|systeminfo|tasklist|quser|curl)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentImageFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
